Part of SWF Constructions

Our story

Why We Started
SWF Marine

SWF Marine is SWF Constructions expanding its reach — bringing marine mechanical and waterfront construction directly to residential and commercial waterfront owners across Sydney. It's always easier having a single contact for multiple trades, and that's what SWF Marine offers.

SWF Marine is the dedicated marine and mechanical arm of SWF Constructions, the Aboriginal-owned Sydney business that's delivered ground-up new home building — including luxury waterfront homes up to $70 million — facilities maintenance, renovations and upgrades since 1995.

Run out of Taren Point, Sydney — close to the harbour and the Northern Beaches, and covering all Southern Sydney locations — SWF Marine handles both trades — engine servicing and repairs, and the jetties, seawalls and waterfront structures the boats tie up to. Same crew, same standards, two trades under one roof.

How we got here

From SWF Constructions
to SWF Marine

1995

SWF Constructions founded

SWF Constructions begins trading as an Aboriginal-owned Sydney construction business, taking on marine and waterfront work across the harbour and coast.

1995 – today

Large home builds across NSW

SWF Constructions delivers large-scale home builds for private clients across NSW — including luxury waterfront homes up to $70 million — alongside waterfront construction and facilities maintenance work such as the Royal Motor Yacht Club Port Hacking and Bellingen Shire Council's Mylestom Tidal Pool.

2025

SWF Marine launches

SWF Constructions' mechanical work becomes its own dedicated division — Blake Fraser and the team, working out of Taren Point, focused on engines, drivelines and everything that makes a boat run.

Today

Two trades, one call

Whether it's an engine that needs work or a jetty that needs rebuilding, it's the same local crew backed by SWF Constructions — no call centre, no middleman.
